lines: Ashwini Amit Dixit, Promoter Group Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling up to 67,500 shares in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹9.13 crore in proceeds, if all offered shares are sold; in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago).
Gain is up to ₹8.45 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained shares are an estimate of ₹64.08 crore, unlocked since 9 Sep 2026.
Event was recent, but the shares unlocked 67 days ago; the family link to Amit Arun Dixit is a possible follow-up angle.
